label: Time
text: ST.O.A2.3 — Reason backward from the end-state (M12) [aos-c01], [gos-c02], [can_we_win-c04], with its experimental limit [gos-c03]. Repetition and the shadow of the future (M10) [gos-c10], [negot-c11], [can_we_win-c12], [advanced-c13]. Rubinstein bargaining [gos-c14]: with two players, alternating offers, an infinite horizon, complete information and discount factors below one, there is a unique subgame-perfect equilibrium with immediate agreement (Rubinstein 1982; uses MA.B.C4 (91A)). Rollback bargaining and outside options [aos-c10]. Grim trigger with forgiveness [negot-c13]. Folk theorem: under infinite repetition, with discount factors close enough to one, any feasible and individually rational payoff can be sustained in equilibrium; for three or more players a full-dimensionality condition is also needed (uses MA.B.C4 (91A)).

warrant.standard: Backward induction or repeated-game result under stated discounting.
warrant.defeaters: Laboratory evidence against rollback [gos-c03]; finite horizons unravel cooperation.
